reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to him on November 3, 2025, so that's the date for the CRM.

I took that from Moss's 2-Nov-2025 digest, which says ownership changes hands "tomorrow", and from Bettina's recap note of 8-Dec-2025, which gives the same date. The reply also mentions that Bettina ran the account day to day until November 21, 2025 and Kwame took over day to day on November 22, 2025.

I wrote the dates as "November 3, 2025" for Kwame. I only use the day-month-year dash format (3-Nov-2025) for Bettina, because that preference came from her DM and applies only to her.
